data: Tesla's diluted earnings per share were **$4.30 in fiscal 2023** and **$3.62 in fiscal 2022**, an increase of about **18.8%**, according to its fiscal 2023 Form 10-K. Net income for fiscal 2023 was **$14,974 million**, and net income attributable to common stockholders was **$14,997 million**, up from $12,556 million in fiscal 2022. The 2023 figure was boosted by a $5,001 million income tax benefit, which came largely from a release of deferred tax assets. Income from operations actually fell, from $13,656 million in 2022 to $8,891 million in 2023.
